caseName: Black Rock Power & Irrigation Co. v. Adamson
caseNameFull: Black Rock Power & Irrigation Company v. W. R. Adamson
attorneys: Mr. Carroll B. Graves, for ap-pellees, in support of the motion to dismiss. Mr. George Donworth, Mr. Elmer E. Todd and Mr. John C. Higgins, for appellant, in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 128, Judicial Code; Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Delaware, Lackwanna & Western R. R. Co. v. Yurkonis, 238 U. S. 439, 444.
